name: sdlc
title: Software delivery lifecycle
summary: Requirements, design, build, test and release with a gate after each stage; fits a defined product or service build.

stages.name: requirements
stages.goal: Agree the problem, users and checkable acceptance criteria.
stages.exit: The user approves the acceptance criteria.
stages.skip_when: The request already states users and acceptance criteria.

stages.name: design
stages.goal: Choose the architecture and interfaces against the criteria.
stages.exit: The user picks one option; dependencies are pinned.
stages.skip_when: A single obvious stack with no external interfaces.

stages.name: build
stages.goal: Build verified features through the feature loop.

stages.name: test
stages.goal: Plan and run tests beyond the feature checks.
stages.exit: Every feature check passes again as a regression run.
stages.skip_when: The feature checks already cover the test strategy.

stages.name: release
stages.goal: Document, reflect on the output and hand over.
stages.exit: Output reflection decides pass or human-review.
